Fit mixture distribution.

Source: R/fit_mixture.R
fit_mixture.Rd

Expectation-Maximization (EM) based fitting of beta mixture densities to numerical samples. Note that the default value for the optional parameter constrain_gt1 is set to FALSE, and that the default value for the optional parameter k is set to 2. These values specify that the EM algorithm will not constrain all beta parameters a and b to be greater than 1, and that the standard AIC definition algorithm will be used. Those settings have been chosen because they match with the default settings in the corresponding SAS function.

Usage

fit_mixture(sample, ...)

Arguments

sample

Object of type bssd_binary_map.

...

extra parameters are passed to automixfit.

Value

object of type mix.

Examples

# Generate prior
set.seed(2021)
H <- 10
time <- 0.5 + cumsum(rexp(H, 5))
# Use constant hazard model:
hazard <- 0.15
prob <- 1 - exp(- hazard * time)
n <- rpois(H, lambda = 100 * time)
y <- rbinom(H, size = n, prob = prob)
x <- stan_map_summary_data(y = y, n = n, time = time,
                           a_alpha = 1 / 3, a_beta = 1 / 3,
                           b_alpha = 5, b_beta = 5)
